markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests InSitu (75%)** · Unreliable input · Defer to expert
Reliability flag is on, the conformal set holds three classes, and the second model disagrees. [F1]

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | InSitu 75%, Normal 10%, Invasive 8% | One clear leader |
| Conformal set | Normal, InSitu, Invasive | Classes not separable |
| Reliability / OOD | 0.07 / 84th percentile | Input flagged suspect |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | No | Different top class |
| Similar cases | 3 of 5 InSitu | Modest support |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (regions 6, 10) · ↑ invasive · Above-typical score; strongest invasive association here [F2] · Validated
- **Marked nuclear pleomorphism** (regions 4, 8, 10) · ↑ invasive · Above-typical score; weaker invasive association · Validated
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (region 11) · ↑ invasive · Low score raises concept-model invasive term; spot check only 12/20 [F4] · Weak
- **Normal lobules** (regions 2, 3, 7) · ↓ invasive · Benign-leaning, but spot check was 0/20 [F3] · Unreliable

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Deletion CI 0.47 to 0.60 excludes 0; faithful to the classifier.
- **Concepts**: Deletion CI −0.005 to 0.007 includes 0; not shown to reflect the classifier, and this case leans on Unreliable normal lobules.

## Could be wrong if
- Low reliability (0.07): blur, stain, or atypical tissue could distort every score.
- Regions 8 and 11 score high for invasive; whole-image 8% may understate focal invasion.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 8, 11, 10**: top classifier contributors; look for stromal invasion versus duct-confined growth.
2. **Regions 6, 10**: confirm tumor-infiltrating stroma, the one validated invasive-associated feature.
3. **Regions 2, 3, 7**: confirm whether normal lobules are present; model check failed.
